name: Soushi Soumai ~Onii-chan, Docchi?~
original_name: 相姉双妹～お兄ちゃん、どっち?～
source:
Summer vacation. After a long time away, I've returned to my family's home, and my two younger sisters are teasing me with their seductive talk. The bright Miu, and the adult-like Yuu. They're twins, and it seems in the time we've been away from each other they've turned into quite the perverted little things...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042551.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假到了。久违地回到老家的我，一进门就被两个双胞胎妹妹用充满挑逗的话语百般撩拨。活泼开朗的美羽，以及成熟稳重的优——似乎在我们分别的这段日子里，这对双胞胎妹妹已经长成了相当好色的小恶魔……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042551.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
